service.description: Share the caller's own location with a record's customer by a guest link: recordType workOrder (a Maintenance work order, recordId its WorkEffort or a step of it) on which the caller is assigned with MAINTENANCE_EXECUTE or MAINTENANCE_SUPERVISE, open (not complete, closed or cancelled), with a planned end (estimatedCompletionDate) and a customer (a customer repair's claim customer). The share ends at thruDate (after now, no later than the planned end; the planned end when not given), exact or approximate (precisionEnumId), with the caller's purposeText (an ETA); it is the framework's create#Share with a link audience, made as the caller, and names the work order (store#ShareRecord), so its completion or cancellation stops it. The link (linkUrl, answered this once: baseUrl, else this server's web root, and the guest page's /location/selector#secret) is mailed to the customer's primary email address by the work order's organization (MANTLE_LOCATION_GUEST_LINK); mailSent false with mailReason (NO_CUSTOMER_EMAIL, NO_SENDER, MAIL_FAILED) when it was not, the share made still. recordType delivery is refused with RECORD_KIND_NOT_READY until the warehouse trips (WH-TRIP) give a Delivery its driver and status. Refused: RECORD_KIND_UNKNOWN, PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_ASSIGNED, WORK_CLOSED, NO_PLANNED_END, NO_CUSTOMER, BAD_UNTIL, END_AFTER_PLANNED, NO_SITE_ROOT, and create#Share's reasons.

parameter.name: baseUrl
parameter.description: The site root of the link, such as https://boss.example.com

parameter.name: linkUrl
parameter.description: The guest page's link, answered this once

service.description: A Maintenance work order completed, closed or cancelled (the EECA LocationShareWorkOrderEnded): every guest share still on for it is stopped (the framework's stop#RecordShares), each on its own. Out: stoppedCount.
